name: Pilon Fracture of the Tibia
definition: Intra-articular fracture of the distal tibial plafond, usually from high-energy axial loading and associated with substantial soft-tissue injury.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are initial; CT after provisional alignment is important for articular fracture planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Definitive fixation is often staged until soft tissues are safe.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-bhagna care may complement recovery after modern stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Intra-articular fracture of the distal tibial plafond, usually from high-energy axial loading and associated with substantial soft-tissue injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
